name: Ladra

attributes.attribute: ship's pilot and brother of Cesair
leader who arrived with fifty handmaidens and three men

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ladra was a hero in the Book of Invasions. He took part in one of the earliest arrivals in Ireland. The lady Cesair came with fifty handmaidens and only three men. Ladra, the ship's pilot and the brother of Cesair, was one of those men. Once the party reached land, he asked for more territory than Cesair would grant. He set out to found his own kingdom, but he died trying to satisfy the many women who had come with him. One text says an oar that pierced his body caused the death. It is unclear whether Ladra is the same figure as Adra or a separate character.

okr.objective: Record Ladra as one of the earliest arrivals in Ireland in the Book of Invasions.
